title: Care Plan Desk Cross-Notice: Upkeep Treatment of a Valuation
content:
The valuation of a traded piece under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is treated according to how the piece has been kept: whether it is covered by a plan in force under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, and how recently an inspection has been logged against it there.

## The notice

Where the piece is covered by a plan in force and an inspection has been logged against it within the last twelve (12) months, the figure stands as worked out (a multiplier of 1.0). Where the piece is covered by a plan in force and the last inspection logged against it is more than twelve but not more than twenty-four (24) months old, the figure is taken at nineteen twentieths (a multiplier of 0.95). Otherwise it is taken at nine tenths (a multiplier of 0.9).

A plan in force is a protection plan on the piece at the active standing. The age of the last inspection is counted in whole months from the date of the inspection that plan records to the handling date.

## By months since the last inspection

| Covered by a plan in force | Months since the last inspection logged | The figure is taken at |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or fewer | the whole of it |
| yes | more than 12, up to and including 24 | nineteen twentieths |
| yes | more than 24 | nine tenths |
| no | any | nine tenths |

An inspection exactly 12 months old falls in the first line; one exactly 24 months old falls in the second; one 25 months old falls in the third.

## Readings on a figure of 6000 USD

- Covered, inspected 5 months ago: 6000.00 USD.
- Covered, last inspected 18 months ago: 5700.00 USD.
- Covered, last inspected 30 months ago: 5400.00 USD.
- Not covered: 5400.00 USD.
